text: R5 Sidebar/shared/Terminal/ChatView/lib review found 1 HIGH issue. Finding: src/store/multiplexer/index.tsx initializes writeGateRef with createWriteGate(false) even when buildInitialState synchronously paints cached web mux state (generation HYDRATED_GENERATION). The gate is only locked in useEffect after first paint, so cached stale tabs/panes can trigger guarded mutating calls before first live mux_get_state reconcile, risking pane-list/tab desync or ghost actions after daemon restart/peer switch. Created cheap-model fix task task_3e39b1b85b0f4afe9c795a5a63607ccb.
